geometry_programs.name: comp25_d01_full_piloti_lift
geometry_programs.rationale: Parent comp24-creative-019 delivers a compact-tall 5-storey mass with ~995m2 footprint leaving only 1463m2 available area on an irregular trapezoidal site. The parking solver placed 4 of 49 required stalls (45 unmet). Surface parking is structurally blocked because the building projection dominates the SE quadrant where the only permissible vehicle access frontage (SE edge [78.23,36.6]->[57.3,0.0]) is located. This child raises the full 1/1 long_axis mass on piloti at rise_ratio=0.20 (~3.8m clearance, one full storey), releasing the complete ~2500m2 site ground plane for parking. From the SE vehicle access edge (~43m clear), a single-loaded 90-degree module (11m depth: 5m stall + 6m aisle) can fit 4 rows along the parcel length = approximately 4 rows × 13 stalls = 52 stalls, satisfying the 49-space requirement including 2 accessible stalls. Spatial benefit: continuous public ground plane under piloti, civic edge on SE road. Conflict: GFA from 4 upper floors at ~800m2/floor = ~3200m2 vs target 4907m2 (-35%); inherited 5-storey/3.8m height preserved; piloti column grid and ground lobby not modelled in this mass stage.

metadata.parking_repair_response: Raises full 1/1 long_axis building on piloti at rise_ratio=0.20 (~3.8m clearance). Full site ground plane ~2500m2 freed for surface parking from SE access edge. Estimated 4 rows * 13 stalls = 52 stalls satisfies 49-space requirement.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA delivered from 4 upper floors ~3200m2 vs contract target 4907m2 (-35%); piloti column spacing and structural capacity unverified at mass stage; ground lobby and vertical circulation core not placed; parking count requires remeasurement against delivered shape and SE frontage.

geometry_programs.name: comp25_d02_half_bar_nw_se_parking
geometry_programs.rationale: The parent 995m2 footprint leaves only ~1463m2 available area, with SE parking limited to a narrow strip. This child uses a 1/2 long_axis seed to occupy only the NW half of the parcel (approximately 500m2 base), concentrating building mass away from the SE vehicle access frontage. The SE half of the site (~1250m2) becomes a clear surface parking zone connected directly to the SE road frontage. From the 43m vehicle access edge, 3 double-loaded rows * ~16 stalls = 48 stalls, satisfying 49 required (marginal; reported as near-satisfying; exact count depends on parcel geometry). A terrace (levels=2, setback_ratio=0.25, direction=x toward open/east) at upper floors steps the NW bar back, reducing shadow toward SE and creating a civic stepped profile. GFA: 1/2 base * 5 storeys * ~500m2/floor = ~2500m2 before terrace + terrace additions = approximately 3000-3500m2 (conflict vs target 4907m2, -30% to -40%; reported).

metadata.parking_repair_response: 1/2 long_axis seed occupies NW half of parcel. SE half ~1250m2 freed for surface parking along SE vehicle access frontage. Estimated 3 double-loaded rows * 16 stalls = 48 stalls; near-satisfying 49 requirement. Terrace steps back at upper floors.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA ~3000-3500m2 vs target 4907m2 (-30-40%); deliberate density trade for parking. Exact parking count requires remeasurement against delivered shape. Terrace direction=x assumed aligned toward SE; parcel orientation to be confirmed.

geometry_programs.name: comp25_d03_split_wing_parking_gap
geometry_programs.rationale: The parking solver failed because the full footprint blocks the SE parking zone. This child splits the 1/1 short_axis mass into two parallel bars with gap_ratio=0.22 (creating ~11m gap on the ~50m parcel short axis = single-loaded 90-deg module depth). The gap runs NW-SE parallel to the vehicle access frontage, providing a clear aisle. Each bar faces the gap: stalls are placed against both bar faces inside the gap, and additional stalls along the SE frontage. Estimated parking: gap 40m run = 8 stalls each side = 16; plus SE strip = 33 stalls; total ~49, satisfying requirement. GFA: two bars, each ~375m2/floor * 5 = 1875m2 * 2 = 3750m2. ground_spine=true joins the two bars at grade with a low connecting slab, ensuring one connected solid; the upper gap remains open for parking. Spatial benefit: covered ground passage under spine between bars creates public through-route. Conflict: gap_ratio measurement depends on parcel dimensions; parking count requires remeasurement against delivered shape.

metadata.parking_repair_response: Splits full 1/1 body into two bars with gap_ratio=0.22 (~11m gap on ~50m parcel). Gap = single-loaded aisle. Gap 40m run * 2 sides = 16 stalls; SE strip ~33 stalls; total ~49 satisfies requirement. ground_spine=true adds a low slab (ground_spine_height_ratio=0.2, ~0.76m) connecting the two bars at grade into one solid; upper gap remains open for parking access.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA ~3750m2 vs target 4907m2 (-24%); gap_ratio exact measurement depends on parcel geometry. Parking count requires remeasurement. ground_spine slab (width_ratio=0.10, height_ratio=0.20) closes the ground gap; its height (~0.76m) is below vehicle clearance so parking runs to the side aisles rather than under the spine. axis=x gap assumed aligns toward SE access; must be confirmed against parcel orientation.

geometry_programs.name: comp25_d04_three_eighth_l_lift
geometry_programs.rationale: This child combines two parking strategies: reduced footprint (3/8 L-shape = 75% of full mass) and piloti lift. The 3/8 long_axis seed creates an L of three octants, whose notch naturally points toward the SE vehicle access. The lift (rise_ratio=0.20, ~3.8m) raises the L mass entirely, leaving the full ~2500m2 ground plane clear for parking. The L notch provides sheltered covered transition at the SE entry where drivers arrive. Parking: same as child 1, ~52 stalls from full ground access. GFA: 3/8 * parent footprint * 5 floors = ~1870m2 (conflict vs 4907m2 target, -62%; reported). Spatial benefit: L geometry creates entry/back-of-house differentiation; piloti corner at notch gives civic presence at vehicle and pedestrian arrival. Unresolved: L orientation controlled by orientation parameter only; actual L notch direction requires confirmation against parcel geometry.

metadata.parking_repair_response: 3/8 L-shape mass raised on piloti at rise_ratio=0.20. Full ~2500m2 ground plane freed. L notch oriented to SE vehicle access entry. ~52 stalls estimated from full ground access.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA ~1870m2 vs target 4907m2 (-62%); large area deficit reported. L orientation and notch direction depend on parcel geometry interpretation. Piloti column grid unverified. Parking count requires remeasurement.

geometry_programs.name: comp25_d05_full_courtyard_se_open
geometry_programs.rationale: The parent solid block at 995m2 footprint leaves insufficient SE ground for parking. This child carves an open courtyard in the SE face of the full 1/1 vertical mass, using courtyard(margin_ratio=0.30, open_side=east). The 30% margin creates a U-shaped building that recedes from the SE road frontage by ~15m (0.30 * ~50m parcel depth), freeing ~750m2 of SE ground inside the courtyard opening plus the remaining SE open strip. Combined available area: ~1463m2 minus building re-footprint = ~1100m2 open SE. Parking from SE: courtyard interior 25m wide * 30m deep = ~750m2 can hold 2 rows * 12 stalls = 24; SE frontage strip = 25 stalls; total ~49, satisfying requirement. GFA: U-plan ~5 floors, area depends on margin but ~4000-4500m2 (conflict vs 4907m2 target, -8% to -18%; reported). Spatial benefit: civic courtyard facing road; U-plan organizes building around central void; parking inside sheltered court.

metadata.parking_repair_response: Carves open-sided courtyard on east (SE access) face with margin_ratio=0.30. U-plan opens ~750m2 interior court + SE frontage strip = ~1100m2 open area. Estimated courtyard 2 rows * 12 stalls = 24 + SE 25 stalls = 49 stalls, satisfying requirement.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA ~4000-4500m2 vs target 4907m2 (-8-18%); courtyard reduces usable floor area. Parking inside open courtyard requires aisle clearance from vehicle access entry; open_side=east maps to parcel SE frontage by program-frame convention; must be confirmed. Parking count requires remeasurement against delivered shape.

geometry_programs.name: comp25_d06_carve_void_se_plus_lift
geometry_programs.rationale: This child combines carve_void and lift to maximize the SE parking envelope while preserving density in the NW portion of the site. First, carve_void(margin_ratio=0.28, open_side=east) removes the SE ~28% of the 1/1 long_axis mass, creating an open SE notch at ground and upper levels. Then lift(rise_ratio=0.20) raises the remaining carved mass on piloti, freeing the entire ground plane (~2500m2). The combination creates a large SE open zone under the carved lift for covered/sheltered parking, plus the full remaining ground plane. Estimated parking: full ground ~2500m2 at 11m module = 4 rows * 13 stalls = 52 stalls, satisfying 49 requirement. GFA: 1/1 - 28% void = ~72% * ~800m2/floor * 4 upper floors = ~2300m2 (conflict vs 4907m2 -53%; reported). Spatial benefit: large sheltered civic entry/arrival zone at SE; clear differentiation between NW programme bar and SE civic/parking base. Conflict: carve_void + lift interaction: lift applied after carve_void; combined rise_ratio=0.20 applied to carved solid; structural column placement at SE corner removed by carve is unverified.

metadata.parking_repair_response: carve_void(margin_ratio=0.28, open_side=east) removes SE ~28% of mass. lift(rise_ratio=0.20) raises carved solid on piloti. Full ~2500m2 ground plane freed. Estimated 4 rows * 13 stalls = 52 stalls satisfies 49 requirement.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA ~2300m2 vs target 4907m2 (-53%); large area deficit from combined carve+lift. carve_void + lift interaction must be verified; structural column placement at SE void corner unverified. open_side=east maps to SE access frontage; parking count requires remeasurement.
